title: Ferrum Anvil planned verification scenario catalog
scope: Seed requirements for agent implementation. Not executable tests or a claim of exhaustive coverage of all source paths. Reconcile with the actual supported source and release inventory.
implementation_rules: Replace each stimulus with a reproducible bounded fixture; retain this scenario ID in test names and result artifacts.
Add exact gateway source/release, protocol, OS, expected ground truth, observable public evidence, authorized detail evidence, confidence ceiling and output artifact paths.
Run current-public-evidence and authorized-enhanced-evidence modes separately when applicable.
Never expose private fixture ground truth to the diagnostic engine under a public-only test.
Per-class seed IDs are suggested live scenarios, not assertions that every protocol emits that class at the same boundary. Confirm the actual path; add typed unit and live/hook variants as needed.
For ambiguous evidence assert uncertainty, alternatives and forbidden-claim absence rather than rewarding a guessed cause.
Run positive control, injected fault and recovery, plus a misleading lookalike where meaningful.
Expand protocol/auth/OS combinations and all newly inventoried plugin/rejection paths; record skips honestly.
Lab-only error hooks must be absent from production packages and identified separately from natural live faults.
universal_assertions: Correct transport/application/assertion separation and response-completeness state.
No secret, private key or unsafe sensitive details in logs/safe-share exports.
No unsupported certainty, automatic security bypass, or automatic unsafe non-idempotent replay.
Bounded time/memory/buffer/event/storage use; no panic or UI hang.
UI explanation, evidence, remediation owner and saved outcome agree with the shared native engine.
Tests verify conditions actually reached using independent fixture ground truth.
